invariant: Every partition count scans the SAME total number of documents; the per-partition cap absorbs the difference. Speedup is computed on compute time, which excludes JVM startup and the one model load per process.
caveat: Spark local mode on one machine. Partitions here are threads sharing RAM and one disk, not executors on separate hosts, so this measures whether the job PARALLELISES, not what a cluster would do. No cluster run exists.
